hero.eyebrow: § small caps line above title, e.g. 'Skala, Kefalonia · since 1987'
hero.title: § 4–8 words, the emotional promise. Idea: wake up across the road from the sea, and sail from the same beach. Must not be generic ('Welcome to paradise' is forbidden). Put a line break marker '\n' where the title should break on desktop.
hero.subtitle: § 1–2 sentences (max 34 words). Two family-run places to stay in Skala + the Captain's daily cruises to Ithaca, Fiscardo and Zakynthos, all booked directly with the family.

intro.kicker: § section label '01 — Who we are' style (no numbers; numbers added by design)
intro.title: § 6–12 words. The family in Skala: rooms by the sea, a captain on the water.
intro.body: § 2 short paragraphs separated by \n\n (max 90 words total). Captain Vangelis was born in Spathi, 5 km from Skala; sea since 18; daily cruises from Skala since 1987; with Frosso they welcome guests at Aegealis on the beach and Theodora in the village. Warm, specific, no clichés.

properties.title: § 6–10 words: two different ways to stay in Skala
properties.intro: § 1–2 sentences: choose the beach or the village; same family, same care.

aegealis.title: Aegealis Studios
aegealis.pitch: § 1–2 sentences: across the road from Skala beach, garden with palms, use of the pools of the two hotels next door, the cruise boat leaves from in front.
aegealis.best: § 'Best for: beach days, couples, sea views'

theodora.title: Theodora Studios & Apartments
theodora.pitch: § 1–2 sentences: at the top of the main street, 100 m from the centre, quiet garden with an orange tree, access to the next-door hotel's pool, a 5–10 minute walk down to the beach.

story.title: § 4–8 words. A love for the sea that never died.
story.body: § 3 short paragraphs separated by \n\n (max 140 words). Paraphrase (not copy) the Captain's story from facts: Spathi 1952; saw the sea at 4 and fell in love; sailed the world; Master's licence 1984; met his wife and chose to stay close to family and the sea; 1987 first cruises from Skala with TARA; six boats later, NIRIIS; '3 loves: my family, the sea, and all of you'. Then: the rooms came from the same hospitality.
